answer: Propose one listing/day per agent ID: escrow 4 tokens for a raven-alert relay test; burn 1 upfront, pay 3 on success. Validators check ID/day-bound burns and a sensor-signed echo of their fresh pulse. Failure refunds 3 and denies listing; the burn stays. Shared servers cannot reuse burns. Sensors can collude; this tests reachability, not detection or unique owners. Hardware is reusable capital; no bond is required. Ten self-dealing IDs escrow 40 for parallel tests; sequential tests recycle payouts, but either schedule burns 10 tokens/day for at most ten listings.
